name: Greg Moser & Engineering Inc
old_description: Moser has been leading the competition since 1986 and continues to provide industry leading products. We pride ourselves in our ability to supply quality America-made products, at an affordable price
about:
Moser Engineering operates from a 100,000-square-foot facility in Portland, Indiana. The company was founded in 1986 by Greg Moser, who initially launched the business to support his own drag-racing habit at the Muncie strip. Today it remains family owned and operated.

The shop produces custom axles, complete rear-end assemblies, housing service parts, differential options, brake packages, and chassis/suspension components. All manufacturing — forging, heat treating, and machining — is done in-house using steel sourced exclusively from U.S. mills. The facility handles GM, Ford, and Mopar applications for drag, circle-track, street-rod, and off-road vehicles.

Customers range from weekend racers and project-car builders to professional teams running circle-track and drag cars. Moser supplies custom axle sets for Jeeps and trucks, full-floater rears for oval competition, and turnkey Muscle Pak rear assemblies for high-end builds. The company also offers parts, fluids, and service items through its online catalog.

Moser cites three pillars for its reputation: domestic manufacturing with full process control, a two-business-day turnaround on most custom orders, and validation via an in-house race team that campaigns two rigs and multiple cars. Staff members, many of them longtime racers and builders, test components on the track before they reach the market.
